object.attr: Shows progress against the preceding equal period. The change is (D - C) / C x 100, D being the selected period total and C the comparison period total. Whole history has no comparison period. Today the code compares the latest month containing a workout with the nearest earlier month containing one. Owner decision, 2026-10-31. Basis: owner decision.
object.description: When the comparison period has a total distance above 0 m, the app shall show on the Stats screen the percentage change from the comparison period to the selected period, truncated to a whole percentage.
